screen.name: Tags
screen.purpose: Manage every tag, pin the ones that should filter Home, and open the tasks for a tag.

search.whileSearching: one list, no Pinned or Other tags headings

other.title: Other tags
other.hiddenWhen: every tag is pinned or there are no tags

sections.order: alphabetical by name within each section

contents: sell icon in the tag color
tagRow.taskCount: tasks already on the device that include the tag
tagRow.rowAction: open Home filtered by this tag

pinAction.pinned: filled push_pin, teal accent, selected surface
pinAction.unpinned: outlined push_pin, neutral icon, default surface

actionsMenu.delete: opens confirmation and does not delete from the menu

create.opens: existing Create new tag bottom sheet
afterCreate: show the tag in the list

visualRules: Use global design tokens from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors, radii, or spacing.
Reuse the Home search interaction, the account menu, the bottom navigation, and the Create new tag bottom sheet.
Do not add a second tag-creation form.
Do not duplicate a pinned tag in Other tags.
Rows stay full width. Long names truncate. Pin buttons keep a 44px target.
The reference image shows composition. Do not measure colors, spacing, or radii from it.

reference.description: Tags management screen with pinned rows above the other tags, a pin control and actions menu on each row, search, create, and Home / Tasks / Tags navigation. The management image shows the menu, edit sheet, and delete confirmation.
